exposure: Echocardiographically determined risk-stratification assignments (Level of Care - LOC)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 747 fetuses diagnosed with congenital heart disease (CHD) who were risk-stratified by echocardiographically determined level of care (LOC) assignment, including a subanalysis of 70 fetuses with coarctation of the aorta.
finding: Risk stratification based on fetal echocardiography can predict neonatal clinical outcomes and acuity of postnatal management needs, with higher LOC assignments correlating with a greater frequency of critical illness, hospital mortality, and need for interventions.
